conventions.name: Kanban board
conventions.description: Drive the conductor's private kanban board: when to file work, how card state maps to the canonical workflow, and how to read {ok:false} refusals.

conventions.name: Report to the board
conventions.description: For a boarded project's workers: proactively file substantive discoveries and log progress, leaving epic and conductor-only moves to the conductor.

tools.name: file_task
tools.description: File a new task for a project. Worker + conductor. Set `priority` here — it is the one moment the level is cheap to judge; omitting it leaves the card unjudged, and an unjudged card sorts below every judged one.

project.description: Target project (must be a live project).

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria; each becomes an unchecked checkbox.

epic.description: Epic slug to file under; the epic must already exist (create_epic).

depends_on.description: Task ids this task depends on.

category.description: Land directly in this lane instead of triage. Omit to file into triage (default).

priority.description: How urgent this is. There is no default: omit it (or send null) and the card stays unset — unjudged, sorting after LOW. An unrecognised value is refused (INVALID_STATE).

plan.description: Link to a plan file, in one of three input forms: `board:<rel>` (under the board's plans/ dir) or `repo:<rel>` (under the project's base checkout) — a pointer that must already resolve to a file and is never copied; a bare relative path (means board:); or an ABSOLUTE path, which is COPIED IN — the file is copied to the board's plans/<id>.md and stored as `board:<id>.md` (the source is never moved or modified; an existing copy is overwritten). Missing/unreadable source or pointer → PLAN_UNKNOWN and no card is created.

tools.name: log_card
tools.description: Log a progress line (a logbook entry) on an in-progress card. Worker + conductor.

project.description: Optional when `id` is omitted; required when `id` is given.

id.description: Optional, conductor-only: target a specific in-progress card. Requires `project`.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List a project's tasks. HIDES `done` BY DEFAULT — pass state:'done' to read that lane, or includeDone:true for every lane. Conductor.

includeDone.description: Include the `done` lane too (default false). No effect when `state` is given.

tools.name: read_task
tools.description: Read a single task including its logbook (optionally only the last logTail entries). Returns plan_path always. Conductor.

logTail.description: Keep only the last N logbook entries.

includePlan.description: Also return the linked plan file's body (plan_body, bounded; plan_truncated / plan_missing flags).

tools.name: read_progress
tools.description: Read a task's logbook only, most-recent first, optionally capped at `limit`. Conductor.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task between board states. Legal: triage->backlog/todo, backlog->todo, todo->in-progress, in-progress->done, plus corrective todo->backlog, in-progress->todo, done->in-progress. Conductor.

owner.description: Session id to attribute as owner when moving to in-progress.

commit.description: Commit sha to stamp when moving to done; omit to auto-capture.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update task fields. `fields` may contain any of: title, goal, epic, priority, depends_on, plan, owner, acceptance (other keys ignored). `priority` is one of CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or null to clear it back to unset (anything else is INVALID_STATE). `plan` takes the same three input forms as `file_task`'s `plan`; `null` clears the link. `owner` may only be set on an in-progress card (else INVALID_STATE). `acceptance` accepts exactly one of three shapes: `{ops:[...]}` — a list of `{op:'add', text}` / `{op:'remove', index}` / `{op:'rename', index, text}` / `{op:'done', index, done}` operations, where `index` is the 0-based position in the card's acceptance list as `read_task` returns it; every op resolves against that single PRE-EDIT snapshot in one pass (two `remove`s in the same call never shift each other), survivors keep their pre-edit relative order, `add`s are appended after all survivors in the order they appear in `ops`; `{replace:[...]}` — sets the list from strings, preserving each item's `done` flag when the new (trimmed) text exactly matches a pre-edit item's text, unmatched items start unchecked; or `null`, which clears the list. Stored criterion text is always trimmed. `file_task`'s `acceptance: string[]` filing-time form is a different shape. Conductor.

fields.description: Subset of {title, goal, epic, priority (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|null), depends_on, plan (board:/repo:/bare relative pointer, or an absolute path that is copied into the board), owner, acceptance}. `acceptance` is itself {ops:[{op:'add'|'remove'|'rename'|'done', index?, text?, done?}]} | {replace:[string,...]} | null — see the tool description for the full op/index/replace contract. Advertised as an opaque object (flat-schema constraint); validated at runtime.

tools.name: create_epic
tools.description: Create or refresh an epic (idempotent upsert). Give exactly one of `project` or `projects`. A re-upsert PRESERVES any optional field you omit — pass `goal: ''` or `plan: null` to clear one explicitly; `title` is always required and always overwrites. Conductor.

project.description: Owning project for a project-scoped epic.

projects.description: Member projects (≥2) for a cross-project epic.

plan.description: Link to the epic's PLAN file. Same three input forms as `file_task`'s `plan`, with these deltas: an ABSOLUTE path is copied to the board's `plans/epic-<slug>.md` and stored as `board:epic-<slug>.md`; a cross-project epic has no owning project, so its `board:` resolves under the BOARD-LEVEL plans/ dir and `repo:` is refused (INVALID_STATE). Missing/unreadable source or pointer → PLAN_UNKNOWN and nothing is written, leaving an existing epic untouched.

tools.name: list_epics
tools.description: List a project's epics, including cross-project epics that span it. Conductor.

tools.name: read_epic
tools.description: Read an epic (goal + plan link + logbook + computed rollup) and its tasks; a cross-project epic aggregates across its member projects. Returns plan_path always. Conductor.

project.description: Owning project for a project-scoped epic, or any member of a cross-project epic (the project's own epic wins). Omit to address a cross-project epic by slug.

logTail.description: Keep only the last N logbook entries.

includePlan.description: Also return the linked plan file's body (plan_body, bounded; plan_truncated / plan_missing flags).

tools.name: log_epic
tools.description: Append a line to an epic's logbook. No lane gate — an epic has no state. Conductor.

project.description: Resolves the epic exactly as `read_epic`'s `project` does.

entry.description: Log line text: what landed, what got resequenced and why.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task by id. Conductor. Irreversible.
